protocol.status: 50 paid train + 20 paid validation rows; arms share the trained model and differ only in which rows become the validation set (exactly paired)
protocol.accounting: router scores and embeddings on unpaid rows are free; each arm pays for the 20 rows it picks

strategies.knn: k-NN disagreement propagation on raw-text embeddings
strategies.boundary: nearest the pool median router score

protocol.validation_role: threshold + epoch for maxacc/cap criteria, epoch only for q criteria (those thresholds come from pool quantiles)
